papers.title: Research on Selective Laser Melting of Ti6Al4V: Surface Morphologies, Optimized Processing Zone, and Ductility Improvement Mechanism
papers.abstract: The quality and mechanical properties of titanium alloy fabricated using selective laser melting (SLM) are critical to the adoption of the process which has long been impeded by the lack of uniformity in SLM-fabrication parameter optimization. In order to address this problem, laser power and scanning speed were combined into linear energy density as an independent variable, while surface morphology was defined as a metric. Based on full-factor experiments, the surface quality of SLM-fabricated titanium alloy was classified into five zones: severe over-melting zone, high-energy density nodulizing zone, smooth forming zone, low-energy density nodulizing zone, and sintering zone. The mechanism resulting in the creation of each zone was analyzed. Parameter uniformity was achieved by establishing a parameter window for each zone, and it also revealed that under smooth forming conditions, the relationship of linear energy density to the quality of the formed surface is not linear. It was also found that fabrication efficiency could be improved in the condition of the formation of a smooth surface by increasing laser power and scanning speed. In addition, maximum elongation of the SLM-fabricated titanium alloy increased when the densified parts were processed using an appropriate heat treatment, from a low value of 5.79% to 10.28%. The mechanisms of change in ductility of the alloy were thoroughly analyzed from the perspectives of surface microstructure and fracture morphology. Results indicate that after heat treatment, the microcosmic structure of the alloy was converted from acicular martensite α’ phase to a layered α+β double-phase structure, the fracture type also changed from quasi-cleavage to ductile fracture.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti6Al4V的SLM工艺参数对表面质量和延展性的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能，与生物医用植入物方向的相关性较弱。
llm.why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks fatigue testing, and does not report surface roughness for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM成形Ti6Al4V的工艺参数以提高表面质量和延展性。
summary_zh.method: 通过全因子实验以线能量密度为变量，划分表面质量区域并分析机理。
summary_zh.result: 建立了光滑成形区参数窗口，热处理后延伸率从5.79%提升至10.28%。
summary_zh.validation: 实验表征表面形貌、微观结构和断口形貌验证机理。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the quality and ductility of Ti6Al4V fabricated by selective laser melting through systematic parameter optimization.
summary_en.method: Full-factor experiments using linear energy density as an independent variable to classify surface quality zones and analyze their formation mechanisms.
summary_en.result: A smooth forming zone was identified, and post-heat treatment increased elongation from 5.79% to 10.28% via α+β phase transformation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization of surface morphology, microstructure, and fracture surfaces validated the proposed mechanisms.

papers.title: Osteoconductive Lattice Microarchitecture for Optimized Bone Regeneration
papers.abstract: Abstract Selective laser melting (SLM) is one methodology to realize additive manufacturing and is mainly used to join metal powder in a layer-by-layer manner to produce a solid three-dimensional (3D) object. For bone tissue engineering purposes, scaffolds can readily be designed as 3D data model and realized with titanium known for its excellent osseointegration behavior. The microarchitecture, that is, design with submillimeter features, of additively manufactured scaffolds is in many cases a lattice structure. This study aimed to apply SLM that allows a high degree of microarchitectural freedom to generate lattice structures and to determine the optimal distance between rods and the optimal diameter of rods for osteoconduction (bone ingrowth into scaffolds) and bone regeneration. For the biological readout, diverse SLM-fabricated titanium implants were placed in the calvarium of rabbits and new bone formation and defect bridging were determined after 4 weeks of healing. The results from the middle section of the defects show that with a lattice microarchitecture, the optimal distance between titanium rods is around 0.8 mm and the optimal rod dimension is between 0.3 and 0.4 mm to optimize defect bridging and bone regeneration.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用SLM制备钛合金多孔支架并评估骨再生，但未涉及应力遮挡、刚度匹配或力学测试，与用户关注方向的直接相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not investigate stress shielding, stiffness matching, or mechanical properties (fatigue/static compression) of the lattice structures; it only focuses on biological bone ingrowth in a rabbit calvarial model.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化钛合金多孔支架的微结构以促进骨再生。
summary_zh.method: 使用SLM制备不同杆间距和直径的钛合金支架，植入兔颅骨模型。
summary_zh.result: 杆间距约0.8 mm、直径0.3-0.4 mm的支架具有最佳的骨再生效果。
summary_zh.validation: 兔颅骨缺损模型植入4周后的组织学分析。

summary_en.motivation: To determine the optimal lattice microarchitecture (rod distance and diameter) of titanium scaffolds fabricated by selective laser melting for enhanced osteoconduction and bone regeneration.
summary_en.method: Titanium lattice scaffolds with varying rod distances and diameters were fabricated via SLM and implanted in rabbit calvarial defects.
summary_en.result: Rod distances around 0.8 mm and rod diameters between 0.3 and 0.4 mm promoted the best bone defect bridging and defect closure after 4 weeks.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit calvarial model with histological analysis of new bone formation and defect bridging after 4 weeks of healing.
